name: Can a hot spot on the floor be a sign of something other than a plumbing leak?

mainEntity.name: Can a hot spot on the floor be a sign of something other than a plumbing leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a hot spot on the floor is most commonly associated with a hot water plumbing leak, especially in homes with slab foundations, it's not the only possibility. In rare cases, electrical wiring issues or even heating elements from radiant floor heating systems (if present) could cause localized warmth. However, these are less frequent culprits. A plumbing professional can accurately differentiate between a water leak and other potential issues using specialized detection tools.
acceptedAnswer.description: Though most often a plumbing leak, a hot spot on the floor could rarely indicate electrical issues or radiant heating problems.
